title: Construction of two nos. of residential quarters (Twin type model) for Navigational Assistant grade - II at Rameswaram DGPS station.
summary: Two-cover online e-tender for constructing two twin-type residential quarters for Navigational Assistant Grade-II staff at Rameswaram DGPS station, Tamil Nadu, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Rameswaram DGPS station, Rameswaram, Tamilnadu
sites.work: Construction of two residential quarters (twin type model) for Navigational Assistant Grade-II

scope.item: Construction of residential quarters (Twin type model) for Navigational Assistant grade - II

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, payable at Chennai, valid three months from technical bid opening. Tender fee non-refundable, by DD in original.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD, State PWD, Railways, MES, BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous body

Similar works completed in last seven years: three >= 40%, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost; only fully completed works with completion certificate; values updated at 7% simple per annum; certificates from officers below Executive Engineer not considered
Similar works = repairs and civil maintenance of building or construction of any type of building/compound wall/retaining wall/RCC work
Key technical personnel for supervision and execution with qualification and experience
Unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure III) and tender acceptance letter (Annexure II)
Affidavit / self-attested declaration of not being blacklisted
List of relatives serving in Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways or DLL
notes: Only the 4-page Section I NIT is posted (no BOQ or drawings). NIT dated 22/11/2022; download/submission 23/11/2022 10:00 to 14/12/2022 15:00; EMD and tender fee originals by 13/12/2022 15:00; opening 15/12/2022 15:00. Listing bid_opening 2022-11-22 is the NIT date, not the opening date. Listed under DGLL, but issued by the Chennai directorate.
